name: Infected
source: Step into a new adventure in a parallel world where humanity has exhausted Earth’s resources and pushed the Moon to the brink of destruction. As a new recruit, you are sent to an underground facility beneath Antarctica, where you must explore a mysterious new world, survive an unexpected infection, uncover hidden secrets, and meet the people trapped alongside you.
